Denominator filter chip

Source: R/filter-denominator.R
cd_denominator_ui.Rd

A filter chip that chooses the denominator the dataset uses, either the vaccination denominator or the maternal one. The choice is kept in the dataset, so every page that reads the denominator follows it. The Denominator Selection page uses one chip for each.

Usage

cd_denominator_ui(id, i18n, allow_input = FALSE, is_maternal = FALSE)

cd_denominator_server(
  id,
  cache,
  i18n,
  label = "title_denom_select_best",
  allowInput = FALSE,
  is_maternal = FALSE,
  display_mode = "combined"
)

Arguments

id

The module's id.

i18n

The app's translator (a shiny.i18n translator), used for every label. The server does not use it.

allow_input

Logical. TRUE draws the chip. Default FALSE, which draws nothing.

is_maternal

Logical. TRUE for the maternal denominator, FALSE (the default) for the vaccination denominator. It decides the chip's label and hint, and which value of the dataset the server reads and saves.

cache

A reactive that returns the dataset, a CacheConnection.

label

Not used.

allowInput

Logical. TRUE keeps the chip and the dataset in step. Default FALSE, which does nothing. Give it the value the ui's allow_input has.

display_mode

Not used.

Value

cd_denominator_ui() returns the UI as Shiny tags (the chip), or NULL when allow_input is FALSE.

cd_denominator_server() returns nothing useful. It is called for what it does.

Details

The chip starts empty and the server fills it from the dataset once the chip is on the page: cache()$denominator, or cache()$maternal_denominator when is_maternal is TRUE. When the value changes in the dataset, the chip follows. When the reader chooses a denominator, the server saves it with the dataset's set_denominator() or set_maternal_denominator(). An empty chip saves nothing.

The chip is drawn, and the dataset kept in step, only when asked for: pass allow_input = TRUE to the ui and allowInput = TRUE to the server (the two arguments are spelled differently). With the defaults the ui is NULL and the server does nothing.

The chip's choices are cd_denominator_options().

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# in a page's ui
cd_denominator_ui(ns("vaxx_denominator"), i18n, allow_input = TRUE)

# in the page's server
cd_denominator_server("vaxx_denominator", cache, i18n, allowInput = TRUE)
} # }
